description: This PHP test class verifies the behavior of the FormatWithEmployeeName class within the OrangeHRM maintenance access strategy. It sets up test data, initializes services, and tests the getFormattedValue method to ensure it correctly formats employee names given an employee ID.

classes.name: FormatWithEmployeeNameTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the FormatWithEmployeeName class's functionality for formatting employee names based on employee IDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including loading test data from a YAML fixture, setting up mock services, and instantiating the format with employee name object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the FormatWithEmployeeName correctly returns the expected formatted employee name for a given employee ID.
